Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'application/pdf', uri: 'https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf'), { 'pdf_options' => { 'extract_metadata' => true, 'hierarchy' => { 'enabled' => true, 'include_bbox' => true, 'k_clusters' => 6 } } })
puts result.results[0].pages.inspect
```
